base.$description: The club's institutional Cool Gray 7C. Decorative only: 2.8:1 on white is below AA for text.

dark.$description: Cool Gray 7C darkened (OKLCH L 0.48): 6.5:1 on white, 5.2:1 on `cool-gray-soft`.

soft.$description: 25% Cool Gray 7C over white: the sent-movement tile.

base.$description: The club's institutional granate, Pantone 188 C. Every tint and shade below derives from it.

dark.$description: Same hue, darker (OKLCH L 0.27): granate-tinted shadows.

deep.$description: The deepest granate: the bottom of the login backdrop, the shade side of lit fills.

glow.$description: Granate lifted (OKLCH L +0.035): the light around the shield on the login backdrop.

base.$description: The club's institutional gold, Pantone 618 C: the currency chip and focus accents on granate. The chip is polished metal graded around it: `gold-light` (OKLCH L 0.93) and `gold-bright` (L 0.82, a touch warmer) catch the light, the official gold is its shade. `gold-ink` is its text: 5.2:1 on the official gold, the darkest stop.

bright.$description: The club's institutional gold, Pantone 618 C: the currency chip and focus accents on granate. The chip is polished metal graded around it: `gold-light` (OKLCH L 0.93) and `gold-bright` (L 0.82, a touch warmer) catch the light, the official gold is its shade. `gold-ink` is its text: 5.2:1 on the official gold, the darkest stop.

dark.$description: Gold's hue darkened (OKLCH L 0.48, C 0.09) into an ink: 6.5:1 on white, 5.2:1 on `gold-soft`, 5.3:1 on `gold-light`. Subscriptions and pending statuses.

ink.$description: The club's institutional gold, Pantone 618 C: the currency chip and focus accents on granate. The chip is polished metal graded around it: `gold-light` (OKLCH L 0.93) and `gold-bright` (L 0.82, a touch warmer) catch the light, the official gold is its shade. `gold-ink` is its text: 5.2:1 on the official gold, the darkest stop.

light.$description: The club's institutional gold, Pantone 618 C: the currency chip and focus accents on granate. The chip is polished metal graded around it: `gold-light` (OKLCH L 0.93) and `gold-bright` (L 0.82, a touch warmer) catch the light, the official gold is its shade. `gold-ink` is its text: 5.2:1 on the official gold, the darkest stop.

soft.$description: 25% gold over white (the same recipe as `primary-soft`): the subscription tile.

cvv-ink.$description: Inks printed on the card: the signature (warmed toward granate) and the CVV digits.

gold.$description: Second card in the Home carousel: satin gold on Pantone 618 C's hue, beside the granate card (the club's two colors). Light (OKLCH L 0.84 / C 0.08) because Visa's blue wordmark stays untouched: 8.7:1 on it, 7.1:1 on the shade. `card-gold-shade` (L 0.78 / C 0.10) is its darkest stop, toward the official gold. Text is `gold-ink` (9.0:1 / 7.3:1); labels are `card-gold-label`, gold's hue at L 0.38 (6.1:1 / 5.0:1).

gold-label.$description: Second card in the Home carousel: satin gold on Pantone 618 C's hue, beside the granate card (the club's two colors). Light (OKLCH L 0.84 / C 0.08) because Visa's blue wordmark stays untouched: 8.7:1 on it, 7.1:1 on the shade. `card-gold-shade` (L 0.78 / C 0.10) is its darkest stop, toward the official gold. Text is `gold-ink` (9.0:1 / 7.3:1); labels are `card-gold-label`, gold's hue at L 0.38 (6.1:1 / 5.0:1).

Light (OKLCH L 0.84 / C 0.08) because Visa's blue wordmark stays untouched: 8.7:1 on it, 7.1:1 on the shade. `card-gold-shade` (L 0.78 / C 0.10) is its darkest stop, toward the official gold. Text is `gold-ink` (9.0:1 / 7.3:1); labels are `card-gold-label`, gold's hue at L 0.38 (6.1:1 / 5.0:1).

signature.$description: Signature-panel paper on gold's hue (OKLCH L 0.97 / 0.92, barely tinted).

signature-ink.$description: Inks printed on the card: the signature (warmed toward granate) and the CVV digits.

signature-line.$description: Signature-panel paper on gold's hue (OKLCH L 0.97 / 0.92, barely tinted).

stripe.$description: Payment card materials (PaymentCardBack): magnetic stripe and signature panel.

stripe-edge.$description: Payment card materials (PaymentCardBack): magnetic stripe and signature panel.

stripe-low.$description: Payment card materials (PaymentCardBack): magnetic stripe and signature panel.

background.$description: Neutral off-white on Cool Gray 7C's hue (OKLCH L 0.982): no blue tint.

border.$description: Cool Gray 7C at 20% over white: hairlines and placeholders.

foreground.$description: Near-black ink on Cool Gray 7C's hue (OKLCH L 0.22): 17.3:1 on white.

muted.$description: Cool Gray 7C's hue, darkened to the lightest grey with AA 4.5:1 on every background it sits on (4.6 on the page and lit surfaces, 4.9 on white). The design's #8a8d9b was 3.2:1.

surface.$description: Neutral off-white on Cool Gray 7C's hue (OKLCH L 0.982): no blue tint.

base.$description: Accessibility exception (README → Brand): errors stay red, because red is what reads as "error" for everyone and granate already means the brand and money in. It is pulled toward granate's hue (OKLCH 0.51 / 0.17 / 24°, granate is 12°) but stays much lighter and more saturated than it. 6.3:1 on white, 5.4:1 on its tint.

on-brand.$description: Errors on the granate login backdrop: 5.8:1 at its lightest, 4.8:1 inside a field.

base.$description: Roles, all on the brand palette: each movement type keeps its own brand color (subscription gold, received granate, sent Cool Gray), and statuses reuse them. Alias of {color.brand.gold.dark}.

soft.$description: Roles, all on the brand palette: each movement type keeps its own brand color (subscription gold, received granate, sent Cool Gray), and statuses reuse them. Alias of {color.brand.gold.soft}.

base.$description: Granate on its soft tint: 6.9:1. Alias of {color.brand.garnet.base}.

soft.$description: Granate on its soft tint: 6.9:1. Alias of {color.brand.garnet.soft}.

base.$description: Pending: gold ink on the light gold, 5.3:1. Alias of {color.brand.gold.dark}.

soft.$description: Pending: gold ink on the light gold, 5.3:1. Alias of {color.brand.gold.light}.

display.$description: Wordmark, screen titles and large amounts. Its x-height is lower than Poppins' (0.40em against 0.55em) and so are its digits (0.60em against 0.74em): titles are set 2px larger than Poppins would be, amounts 4px.

shimmer-period.$description: Period of the skeleton's looping highlight (a rhythm, not a transition).

stagger-step.$description: Delay between consecutive list rows; at most 6 rows stagger (movement-motion.ts).

1.$description: Elevation 1: controls resting on the page (inactive chips, small surfaces).

card.$description: Elevation 2: cards, rows, the default surface.

float.$description: Elevation 4: bars floating over content (bottom nav); the shade rises above it.

on-brand.$description: A white control resting on the granate backdrop (login button).

pressed.$description: A granate fill pressed into the page: only the contact shadow is left.

raised.$description: Elevation 3: a granate fill raised toward the light (primary button, active chip).

pressed.$description: Pressed: the highlight is gone and the top inner edge is in shade.

recessed.$description: Recessed fields (inputs): shade on the inner top edge, light on the outer bottom.

recessed-on-brand.$description: A field pressed into the granate backdrop (login).

specular.$description: Specular edges: the top edge catches the light, the bottom edge turns away from it.

specular-glass.$description: Specular edges: the top edge catches the light, the bottom edge turns away from it.

specular-gold.$description: Gold chip: a bright top edge (polished metal) and a hint of its own deeper gold below.

specular-soft.$description: Specular edges: the top edge catches the light, the bottom edge turns away from it.
